segments.teaches: India has about 140 crore people; existing banks (cooperative banks, commercial banks, regional rural banks) serve only part of them

elements.what: India silhouette on the top-left corner of a framed box
dense row of people silhouettes labelled 140 crores
yellow shade over the left part of the crowd, extending down below the box
three bank types under the yellow part: cooperative badge, commercial bank building, rural bank hut

segments.notes: Excellent: coverage shown as a shaded share of a crowd connected to the banks that create it. Almost no words. [Events: 4 add, 1 big/reset in 34 s, about one change every 7 s.]
segments.idea: Only part of India's population is covered by the existing banks.
segments.shown_as: an India map tops a framed crowd labelled 140 crore; a yellow shade spreads over the left part of the crowd and drops down like a pocket holding three bank types (cooperative, commercial, rural) - the shaded part is who the banks reach

segments.teaches: a large part of the people, especially in remote areas, is still outside banking; the 2014-15 budget speech called for a structure to take banking to every household; financial inclusion became the priority

elements.what: dark-red dome over the right, unshaded part of the crowd (unbanked)
real photo of the then finance minister, linked to the dome by a line
pink quote box with big quote marks, attributed to the 2014-15 budget speech
blue underline on the key words of the quote
PRIORITY heading with a green-grey 'financial inclusion' chip pointing at the map

segments.notes: Unbanked shown as a red dome over the rest of the crowd, pairing with the yellow banked share. Real person photo and quote: BIE will not use real people; it can cite the speech in text. [Events: 1 add, 1 big/reset in 21 s, about one change every 11 s.]
segments.idea: The unbanked share became a national priority: financial inclusion.
segments.shown_as: the unshaded right part of the crowd is capped by a dark-red dome (the unbanked); a line runs from the dome to a photo of the then finance minister with a pink quote box; key words get a blue underline, and a 'priority: financial inclusion' tag points at the map

segments.teaches: the RBI's 2013 report on micro-finance concerns showed why existing banks could not reach this segment: limited reach due to high operating costs and poor infrastructure, high fees deterring poor households and small businesses, and no suitable products

elements.what: yellow report-title chip with the year 2013
report document icon
RBI coin emblem
beige shelf holding the three existing bank types with labels
heading: why existing banks cannot reach the micro-finance segment
pink reason boxes with bold key words
finance minister photo kept in the corner

segments.notes: About 70 s of reading. Each reason could be pictured: a bank far from a village (reach), a fee tag scaring off a shopkeeper (cost), a product that does not fit. The photo stays as decoration. [Events: 6 add, 1 big/reset in 72 s, about one change every 10 s.]
segments.idea: Old bank types could not serve the poor: too costly to reach, too expensive to use, wrong products.
segments.shown_as: the canvas resets to a yellow report tag with the RBI mark and a document icon over a beige shelf of the three existing bank types; a heading asks why they cannot reach the micro-finance segment and three pink reason boxes stack down one by one
segments.example: RBI report of 2013 on micro-finance concerns

segments.teaches: so the RBI proposed differentiated banks: banks with a distinct business model, licensed to give specific kinds of banking services

elements.what: curved arrow from the RBI mark to the new title
green 'differentiated banks' title
blue definition box with a black side bar

segments.notes: Definition is one sentence in a box; no picture of a 'narrow licence' (for example a licence card with only some service icons allowed). [Events: 2 add, 0 big/reset in 22 s, about one change every 11 s.]
segments.idea: Differentiated banks are licensed to do only specific banking jobs.
segments.shown_as: a curved arrow from the RBI mark points to a green 'differentiated banks' title and a blue definition box writes on beneath it, beside the reasons

segments.teaches: differentiated banks are of two kinds, small (finance) banks and payments banks; small banks have three features: targeted approach, technology driven, flexibility in operations

elements.what: definition box moved to the left
small bank building labelled SMALL BANK
payments bank icon: phone with a card and a little bank
numbered circles 1-3 with three feature words under the small bank

segments.notes: Numbered feature list becomes a sidebar 'menu' whose items light up one by one in the next segments: a clear chaptering device. [Events: 3 add, 2 big/reset in 22 s, about one change every 4 s.]
segments.idea: Two new bank types; the small bank's three features are the plan for the next part.
segments.shown_as: the definition slides left and two icons pop in side by side - a small bank building and a phone-with-card-and-bank icon for the payments bank; numbered circles 1-3 drop under the small bank, then the rest fades and the small bank moves to a left sidebar

segments.teaches: targeted approach: small banks serve marginalised groups (farmers, micro and small enterprises, low-income households) in a limited area set by the RBI at licence time, with a focus on unbanked rural and remote regions

blue note: licences focus on unbanked rural and remote regions

segments.notes: Targeting drawn as circles inside a crowd linked by dotted lines to a bank: strong. Text then piles up below (list plus two notes). [Events: 5 add, 1 big/reset in 66 s, about one change every 11 s.]
segments.idea: Small banks are aimed at specific poor groups within a fixed area.
segments.shown_as: a long crowd fills the right panel and four red circles ring small clusters inside it - the marginalised groups; two small bank buildings appear above and drop dotted lines straight into those circles, so each bank serves its own targeted cluster; the 'targeted approach' item glows in the sidebar menu
segments.example: farmers, micro and small enterprises, low-income households

segments.teaches: technology driven: small banks are expected to use technology to give cheap, efficient service

segments.idea: Small banks keep costs low by using technology.

segments.teaches: flexibility in operations: small banks may work in both urban and rural areas and serve a wide range of customers

segments.idea: Small banks can serve both town and village customers.
segments.shown_as: the tech rings clear and the crowd is painted in two halves - grey 'urban' and green 'rural' - with a small bank's dotted lines reaching into both halves; 'flexibility' lights up in the sidebar

segments.teaches: the second type is the payments bank; before 2013 many digital wallets were already working in India and their use was growing fast

segments.example: 140-crore crowd box reused; wallet companies named as examples (before 2013)

segments.teaches: in 2014 the RBI licensed payments banks (wallet firms could become one): they may accept demand deposits and give payment, remittance and internet banking services, but may not lend

elements.what: yellow box titled DIGITAL WALLETS holding four wallet icons
arrow into a licence card under the RBI mark, and another out to the payments bank
licence card under the RBI coin
payments bank icon in a yellow box, 'introduced in 2014'
allowed services with green squares
'credit lending' added to the list and struck through in red

segments.notes: Licence card as a gate between 'before' and 'after' is a strong reusable picture. Striking out one listed service shows a restriction cleanly. [Events: 3 add, 1 big/reset in 57 s, about one change every 14 s.]
segments.idea: A wallet firm passes through an RBI licence and comes out as a payments bank that can hold and move money but cannot lend.
segments.shown_as: the wallet icons sit in a yellow box; an arrow runs into a licence card under the RBI mark and another arrow out to a phone-and-bank icon labelled 'introduced 2014' - the licence turns a wallet into a bank; a list of allowed services writes on below, then 'credit lending' joins the list and is struck out in red

segments.teaches: payments banks cannot lend because lending carries credit risk; they may not set up NBFC subsidiaries; other entities that meet RBI criteria can also apply for the licence

elements.what: pale-blue reason note beside the struck-out lending line: credit risk

'Or, any entity meeting RBI criteria' box with an elbow arrow into the licence card

segments.notes: Blocked path = dotted arrow with a red X on it. The row of up-arrows under the NBFC note has no clear meaning from stills. Second entry route into the same licence card is neat. [Events: 4 add, 1 big/reset in 76 s, about one change every 15 s.]
segments.idea: Payments banks are kept away from lending risk, and wallets are not the only ones who can apply.
segments.shown_as: the view shifts left; a reason note sits beside the struck-out 'lending'; a dotted arrow from the payments bank climbs to a piggy bank labelled NBFC and is blocked by a red X; a row of thin up-arrows rises under the rule note; finally an 'or any eligible entity' box sends an elbow arrow into the licence card as a second entry route
